description: PSWS native Digital RF (DRF) Observations. The standard CSV representation is an Observation manifest. Requesting format=x_drf_zip returns every complete native Observation whose approximately 24-hour interval overlaps the requested HAPI time interval. DRF Observations are not time-sliced and individual subchannels are not extracted by the server; users select subchannels after download with Digital RF software.

x_psws.nativeSelection: complete Observations overlapping the requested interval

parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: Start time encoded in the native OBS... directory name

parameters.name: Observation
parameters.description: Native Digital RF Observation directory name, for example OBS2026-08-27T00-01
